resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO

access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code; supports PBE and hybrid functionals (HSE06). The agent must compile or use a pre-built version with appropriate libraries.

resources.notes: The paper originally used VASP; QE is an open-source equivalent that can produce comparable structural and band-gap results.

resources.name: SSSP efficiency pseudopotentials

access.notes: Library of PAW/Pseudodojo pseudopotentials for Quantum ESPRESSO, including PBE and HSE06-compatible potentials for Bi, Nb, Mg, Li, O.

resources.notes: Agent should select appropriate pseudopotentials from the SSSP efficiency library.
